::: {#exm-chi-square-dist}
#### The 0.95 quantile of $\chi^2_1$

By @def-chi-square-dist, a $\chi^2_1$ random variable is $Z^2$
for a standard Gaussian $Z$.
So $\Pr(Z^2 \le c) = \Pr(-\sqrt{c} \le Z \le \sqrt{c})$,
and the 0.95 quantile of $\chi^2_1$
is the square of the 0.975 quantile of the standard Gaussian distribution:

```{r}
c(chisq = qchisq(0.95, df = 1), gaussian_squared = qnorm(0.975)^2)
```

:::
